symptom: describe java action printed `-- export level: Public`; after `fix widgets` the line was gone and the stored ExportLevel was Hidden, reported as a silently lost API level.
cause: "Public" is not a JavaActionsExportLevel member (Hidden | API); older mxcli wrote it on every Java action rewrite (#705). Mendix reads an unknown value as the default: mx update-widgets 11.12.6 re-saved Public as Hidden and kept a stored API as API.
fix: describe prints API as `-- export level: API` and any other non-default value with a note that it is not a Mendix export level, that Mendix reads it as Hidden, and how to set API. fix widgets no longer rewrites Java actions (#2288), so the stored value is not touched.
insight: Before treating a changed value as data loss, check it is a value the platform has: the enum in modelsdk/gen settled it in one grep, and a control with the valid API value showed mx preserves real levels. A probe that sets a raw property is a 30-line Go main using the backend's GetRawUnitByName + UpdateRawUnit.
